description: Piccinini, Alessandro and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The existing ModSCO web application uses reduced-order building models to assess energy-conservation measures and close the gap between predicted and measured building performance. Source examples assess calibration using ASHRAE Guideline 14. It supports rapid parametric or scenario analysis with reduced computational requirements. This is an actual modelling application described in a publication, although the inspected metadata do not establish current hosted access, a public source repository or code-reuse terms. The publication licence applies to its deposit. Detailed model structures and site-specific parameter availability remain limited to the source description. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
